name: @firstreply/mcp

tools.name: organization_list
tools.description: List the organizations the token can access, including ids, names and plans: an organization API key sees only its own organization. Use the organizationId in all other tools.

tools.name: organization_get
tools.description: Get an organization: name, default language, description, plan, auto-close setting and the custom AI prompts (persona, reply instructions, classification instructions).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: organization_update
tools.description: Update the settings of an organization. Only provide fields to change. Requires organization admin permission.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

language.description: Default language of the team (two-letter code, e.g. "en"). Incoming messages in other languages are translated into it.

autoCloseInactivityDays.description: Close conversations automatically after this many days without activity; 0 disables it.

aiPromptEgo.description: Custom AI persona prompt (role, tone, capabilities) that replaces the built-in one for AI replies. Empty restores the default.

aiPromptConfig.description: Custom response rules for AI replies (formatting, what to avoid). Empty restores the default.

aiPromptClassification.description: Custom instructions for classifying incoming messages. Empty restores the default.

tools.name: organization_usage
tools.description: Plan and usage of an organization: plan name, trial / active / cancelled state, channel and member counts against the plan limits.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: member_list
tools.description: List the members of an organization with their profile and permission level. Use member ids to assign conversations.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: member_get
tools.description: Get one organization member by id.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: member_create
tools.description: Add a member to an organization by email address. Requires organization admin permission.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

email.description: Email address of the person to add.

permission.description: Permission level: 1 = member (sees assigned conversations), 2 = manager, 3 = admin (settings, API keys), 4 = owner.

tools.name: member_update
tools.description: Change the permission level of an organization member. Requires organization admin permission.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

permission.description: Permission level: 1 = member (sees assigned conversations), 2 = manager, 3 = admin (settings, API keys), 4 = owner.

tools.name: member_delete
tools.description: Remove a member from an organization. Their assigned conversations stay in the organization. Requires organization admin permission.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

memberId.description: The organization member id to remove.

tools.name: api_key_list
tools.description: List the named API keys of an organization (name, masked prefix, created, last used, expiry). Never returns the key values. Requires organization admin permission.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: api_key_create
tools.description: Create a new named API key for an organization. The response contains the plaintext key exactly once: relay it to the user immediately and treat it as a secret; it cannot be retrieved later. Requires organization admin permission.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

name.description: A descriptive name for the key, e.g. the integration that will use it.

expirationDays.description: Days until the key expires. Omit or 0 for a key that never expires.

tools.name: api_key_delete
tools.description: Delete (revoke) an API key of an organization. Integrations using the key stop working immediately, including this MCP server if the key it authenticates with is deleted. Requires organization admin permission.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

apiKeyId.description: The id of the API key to delete (see api_key_list).

tools.name: channel_list
tools.description: List the channels of an organization: email, website chat, WhatsApp, Facebook Page (MESSENGER), Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, X, TikTok, YouTube, Google Business Profile, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Google Play and App Store, with their type, name and health. publishingEnabled marks the social accounts posts can be published to (see post_schedule).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: channel_get
tools.description: Get one channel by id: type, name, connected account or mail server, signature, health and activation state.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: channel_statistics
tools.description: Statistics per channel of an organization (conversation volumes).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: channel_refresh
tools.description: Fetch new messages from a channel now instead of waiting for the next scheduled retrieval.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: channel_test
tools.description: Test the connection of a channel to its platform (mail server, Meta, Google, Apple, ...) and report the result.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: channel_create
tools.description: Create a channel that is set up with settings or credentials: EMAIL, WEBCHAT, BLUESKY, TELEGRAM, APPSTORE, PLAYSTORE (website chat needs none; the result carries the webchatKey of its embed snippet). Pass the fields of that type. Accounts that are connected by signing in (MESSENGER, INSTAGRAM, LINKEDIN, WHATSAPP, THREADS, X, TIKTOK, YOUTUBE, GOOGLE_BUSINESS, MASTODON) are started with channel_connect instead. FirstReply checks the credentials with the platform before it saves. Needs manager rights and a free channel in the plan (organization_usage).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

name.description: Name of the channel as the team sees it.

blueskyHandle.description: BLUESKY: the account's handle, e.g. example.bsky.social.

publishingEnabled.description: Social accounts: let posts be published to this channel (post_schedule). Counts against the plan's publishing limit; the channel has to be allowed to publish (publishingAuthorized, see channel_connect).

commentMode.description: Social accounts: which comments on posts become conversations. ALL, QUESTIONS (emoji-only and off-topic comments are closed quietly) or NONE.

commentAutoReply.description: Social accounts: send AI replies to comments right away instead of keeping them as drafts.

emailHost.description: EMAIL: mail server host name, e.g. mail.example.com.

emailUsername.description: EMAIL: the mailbox address, which is also the login.

emailPassword.description: EMAIL: the mailbox password. Stored encrypted, never returned.

webchatTitle.description: WEBCHAT: title shown in the widget.

webchatColor.description: WEBCHAT: accent color as hex, e.g. #2563eb.

webchatPosition.description: WEBCHAT: side of the page the launcher sits on.

webchatLauncherLabel.description: WEBCHAT: text next to the launcher button.

webchatRequireContact.description: WEBCHAT: ask visitors for name and email before they can write.

webchatAllowedDomains.description: WEBCHAT: comma-separated domains the widget may be embedded on. Empty allows every site.

blueskyAppPassword.description: BLUESKY: an app password (Bluesky settings, Privacy and security, App passwords), never the account password. Stored encrypted.

telegramBotToken.description: TELEGRAM: the token of the bot from @BotFather. Stored encrypted.

telegramChat.description: TELEGRAM: the Telegram channel the bot posts to (@name, a t.me link or the id); the bot has to be an administrator of it. Optional: without it the channel only receives messages to the bot.

appstoreAppId.description: APPSTORE: the app's Apple ID (the number in its App Store link).

appstoreIssuerId.description: APPSTORE: issuer id of the App Store Connect API key.

appstoreKeyId.description: APPSTORE: key id of the App Store Connect API key.

appstorePrivateKey.description: APPSTORE: content of the .p8 private key file. Stored encrypted.

playstorePackageName.description: PLAYSTORE: the app's package name, e.g. com.example.app. The organization's service account (channel_playstore_service_account) has to be invited in the Play Console first.

tools.name: channel_connect
tools.description: Start connecting an account that is connected by signing in on the platform: MESSENGER, INSTAGRAM, LINKEDIN, WHATSAPP, THREADS, X, TIKTOK, YOUTUBE, GOOGLE_BUSINESS, MASTODON (MESSENGER is a Facebook Page). Returns a link (authUrl): the user opens it in a browser where they are signed in to FirstReply as the organization's owner, signs in on the platform, and FirstReply creates the channel; when the login can connect several accounts (Pages, locations, ...) FirstReply asks which one. The link is valid for 10 minutes. With channelId it reconnects that channel instead: after an expired or revoked login, or to grant more capabilities. Facebook Pages grant one capability per login, so ask for one at a time (first connect, then once more with channelId for PUBLISHING). Afterwards check channel_get: publishingAuthorized tells whether posts are allowed, channel_update turns publishingEnabled on.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

platform.description: The platform of a new channel. Not needed with channelId.

name.description: Name of the new channel as the team sees it. Required without channelId.

channelId.description: An existing channel to reconnect instead of creating one.

capabilities.description: What the login asks for on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok (TikTok: COMMENTS on a reconnect adds the comments login). Default MESSAGING. Other platforms have one login for everything.

server.description: MASTODON: the server the account is on, e.g. mastodon.social.

tools.name: channel_update
tools.description: Change a channel: its name, whether it is active, publishing and comment handling of a social account, or the settings and credentials of its type. Only what is given changes. Turning publishingEnabled on makes the channel a target for post_schedule. A new login of a connected account is channel_connect with the channelId.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

activated.description: false pauses the channel: nothing is fetched or sent.

publishingEnabled.description: Social accounts: let posts be published to this channel (post_schedule). Counts against the plan's publishing limit; the channel has to be allowed to publish (publishingAuthorized, see channel_connect).

commentMode.description: Social accounts: which comments on posts become conversations. ALL, QUESTIONS (emoji-only and off-topic comments are closed quietly) or NONE.

commentAutoReply.description: Social accounts: send AI replies to comments right away instead of keeping them as drafts.

emailHost.description: EMAIL: mail server host name, e.g. mail.example.com.

emailUsername.description: EMAIL: the mailbox address, which is also the login.

emailPassword.description: EMAIL: the mailbox password. Stored encrypted, never returned.

webchatTitle.description: WEBCHAT: title shown in the widget.

webchatColor.description: WEBCHAT: accent color as hex, e.g. #2563eb.

webchatPosition.description: WEBCHAT: side of the page the launcher sits on.

webchatLauncherLabel.description: WEBCHAT: text next to the launcher button.

webchatRequireContact.description: WEBCHAT: ask visitors for name and email before they can write.

webchatAllowedDomains.description: WEBCHAT: comma-separated domains the widget may be embedded on. Empty allows every site.

blueskyAppPassword.description: BLUESKY: an app password (Bluesky settings, Privacy and security, App passwords), never the account password. Stored encrypted.

telegramBotToken.description: TELEGRAM: the token of the bot from @BotFather. Stored encrypted.

telegramChat.description: TELEGRAM: the Telegram channel the bot posts to (@name, a t.me link or the id); the bot has to be an administrator of it. Optional: without it the channel only receives messages to the bot.

appstoreAppId.description: APPSTORE: the app's Apple ID (the number in its App Store link).

appstoreIssuerId.description: APPSTORE: issuer id of the App Store Connect API key.

appstoreKeyId.description: APPSTORE: key id of the App Store Connect API key.

appstorePrivateKey.description: APPSTORE: content of the .p8 private key file. Stored encrypted.

playstorePackageName.description: PLAYSTORE: the app's package name, e.g. com.example.app. The organization's service account (channel_playstore_service_account) has to be invited in the Play Console first.

tools.name: channel_playstore_service_account
tools.description: The Google service account of the organization for Google Play reviews (created on the first call). The user invites its email in the Play Console (Users and permissions, with the permission to reply to reviews) before channel_create with type PLAYSTORE works.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: channel_tiktok_creator_info
tools.description: What a TikTok channel may post right now, read from TikTok: the privacy levels the account offers, whether comments, duets and stitches can be allowed and the longest video. A TikTok target of post_schedule needs a privacyLevel from this list.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_list
tools.description: List customer conversations of an organization, highest priority and most recent activity first (by relevance when searching). All filters are optional and combine. Each result carries the subject, status, priority, classification, assignee, contact, language and the last message.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

status.description: Filter by status; "open" is unread + read.

assignedMemberId.description: Filter by assigned organization member id.

contactId.description: Filter by contact id: the conversations of one customer.

language.description: Filter by the customer's language (two-letter code).

spam.description: true lists only conversations marked as spam, false only the others. Omit for the default listing.

priority.description: Filter by exact priority (higher = more urgent).

search.description: Full text search over subject, messages and contact. Words are AND-ed and prefix matched. Use "quoted phrases", -word to exclude, and the operators from:<sender name or email>, subject:<text>, is:<open|closed|unread|read|assigned|unassigned|ai>, has:<attachment|draft>, before:<YYYY-MM-DD>, after:<YYYY-MM-DD>.

createdAfter.description: Only conversations created at or after this time. ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.

createdBefore.description: Only conversations created at or before this time. ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.

updatedAfter.description: Only conversations updated at or after this time. ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.

updatedBefore.description: Only conversations updated at or before this time. ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.

tools.name: conversation_get
tools.description: Get a customer conversation by id: subject, status, priority, classification (with the AI's reason and confidence), assignment, contact, language and last message.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_thread
tools.description: Get a conversation together with all of its messages in one call. Prefer this over conversation_get + conversation_messages when the full history is needed.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

markRead.description: Also mark the conversation as read (default false).

tools.name: conversation_messages
tools.description: List the messages of a conversation, newest first. Each message carries sender, recipients, plain text, detected language, a translation into the team's language when they differ, and draft / internal note flags.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_reply
tools.description: Send a reply to the customer in a conversation, delivered through the conversation's channel (email, WhatsApp, ...). Sending is irreversible: only call it with a text the user has approved. Set internal=true to add an internal note visible to the team only, or draft=true to store a draft the team can review and send with message_send.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

message.description: The plain text of the reply, note or draft.

internal.description: true stores the text as an internal note instead of sending it.

draft.description: true stores the text as a draft instead of sending it.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language of message when it was translated for the customer (see ai_translate). Send together with translation.

translation.description: The text as the agent wrote it, when message is a translation of it. Kept alongside the sent text.

tools.name: conversation_close
tools.description: Close a customer conversation.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_read
tools.description: Mark an unread conversation as read.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_spam
tools.description: Mark a conversation as spam, or undo that with spam=false.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

spam.description: false marks the conversation as not spam (default true).

tools.name: conversation_update
tools.description: Update a customer conversation: assign it to a member, change priority, status, classification, subject, language, contact or spam flag. Only provide fields to change.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

assignedMemberId.description: Organization member id to assign the conversation to (see member_list).

language.description: Customer language (two-letter code) when the detected one is wrong.

contactId.description: Move the conversation to another contact (see contact_list).

tools.name: conversation_delete
tools.description: Delete a conversation and all of its messages permanently.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_stats
tools.description: Daily counts of opened and closed conversations of an organization for a date range.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_stats_by_member
tools.description: Conversation statistics per organization member for a date range: who handled how many conversations.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_metrics
tools.description: Support metrics of an organization for a date range: totals and closing rate, first reply times (median, p90, average), AI reply share, sentiment share, closing rate over time, close reasons and closes per member.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: conversation_totals
tools.description: Current conversation totals of an organization (e.g. open and unread counts).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: message_get
tools.description: Get one message by id: sender, recipients, subject, plain text, detected language, translation, attachments and the draft / internal note flags.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

messageId.description: The message id (see conversation_messages or conversation_thread).

tools.name: message_update
tools.description: Edit a draft or an internal note before it is sent: replace its text, subject, language or translation. Only provide fields to change. Sent messages cannot be edited.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

messageId.description: The message id (see conversation_messages or conversation_thread).

language.description: Two-letter language code of the text.

translation.description: The text as the agent wrote it, when message is a translation of it.

tools.name: message_send
tools.description: Send a draft message to the customer through the conversation's channel. Irreversible: only call it after the user approved the draft (read it with message_get first).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

messageId.description: The message id (see conversation_messages or conversation_thread).

tools.name: message_delete
tools.description: Delete a message permanently, e.g. a draft or an internal note.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

messageId.description: The message id (see conversation_messages or conversation_thread).

tools.name: contact_list
tools.description: List or search the contacts (customers) of an organization: name, email, phone, messaging ids, custom fields and conversation count.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

senderOnly.description: true lists only contacts who have written to the organization.

tools.name: contact_get
tools.description: Get one contact by id, including custom field values and the number of conversations.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

contactId.description: The contact id (see contact_list or the contactId of a conversation).

tools.name: contact_create
tools.description: Create a contact. Provide at least a name or an email address.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

name.description: Display name, when first and last name are not known separately.

description.description: Free text notes about the contact.

key.description: Key of a custom contact field (see contact_field_list).

fields.description: Custom field values. Fields not listed keep their value.

tools.name: contact_update
tools.description: Update a contact. Only provide fields to change.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

contactId.description: The contact id (see contact_list or the contactId of a conversation).

description.description: Free text notes about the contact.

key.description: Key of a custom contact field (see contact_field_list).

fields.description: Custom field values. Fields not listed keep their value.

tools.name: contact_delete
tools.description: Delete a contact permanently.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

contactId.description: The contact id (see contact_list or the contactId of a conversation).

tools.name: contact_field_list
tools.description: List the custom contact fields defined in an organization (key, name, type: 0 = text, 1 = link, 2 = button). Use the keys with contact_create and contact_update.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: classification_list
tools.description: List the classifications of an organization with their automation settings (AI reply, draft, auto close, default assignee, prompt, template).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: classification_get
tools.description: Get one classification by id.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: classification_create
tools.description: Create a classification.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

description.description: What kind of conversations belong here; the AI uses it to classify incoming messages.

color.description: Color index shown in the app.

aiReply.description: true lets the AI answer conversations of this classification automatically.

aiReplyDraft.description: true makes the AI prepare a draft for the team instead of sending its reply.

sentimentAnalysis.description: true enables sentiment analysis for these conversations.

autoClose.description: true closes a conversation automatically after the AI replied.

defaultMemberId.description: Member id these conversations are assigned to by default (see member_list).

promptId.description: Prompt id the AI uses for replies here (see prompt_list).

templateId.description: Template id used for replies here (see template_list).

tools.name: classification_update
tools.description: Update a classification. Only provide fields to change.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

description.description: What kind of conversations belong here; the AI uses it to classify incoming messages.

color.description: Color index shown in the app.

aiReply.description: true lets the AI answer conversations of this classification automatically.

aiReplyDraft.description: true makes the AI prepare a draft for the team instead of sending its reply.

sentimentAnalysis.description: true enables sentiment analysis for these conversations.

autoClose.description: true closes a conversation automatically after the AI replied.

defaultMemberId.description: Member id these conversations are assigned to by default (see member_list).

promptId.description: Prompt id the AI uses for replies here (see prompt_list).

templateId.description: Template id used for replies here (see template_list).

tools.name: classification_delete
tools.description: Delete a classification. Conversations that use it are moved to reassignTo or left unclassified. Use classification_impact first to see how many conversations and knowledge entries are affected.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

reassignTo.description: Classification id that affected conversations are moved to.

tools.name: classification_impact
tools.description: Preview what deleting a classification would affect (conversations, knowledge entries).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: classification_statistics
tools.description: How many conversations fall into each classification of an organization.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search the knowledge base of an organization (full text: words are AND-ed and prefix matched, "quoted phrases", -word to exclude). Omit search to browse all entries. Entries are question / answer pairs (prompt / completion); synced articles are split into chunks that share a source.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

sourceId.description: Only entries synced from this knowledge source.

tools.name: knowledge_get
tools.description: Get one knowledge entry by id.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: knowledge_create
tools.description: Add a knowledge entry the AI can use for replies: a question or topic and its answer.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

classificationId.description: Classification this entry belongs to (see classification_list).

positive.description: false marks the entry as a negative example (default true).

tools.name: knowledge_update
tools.description: Update a knowledge entry. Only provide fields to change.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

positive.description: false marks the entry as a negative example.

tools.name: knowledge_delete
tools.description: Delete a knowledge entry permanently.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: knowledge_source_list
tools.description: List the knowledge sources of an organization (websites, GitHub, Notion, GitBook, ...) with their sync state, last sync time, last error and number of synced entries.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: knowledge_source_get
tools.description: Get one knowledge source by id.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: knowledge_source_sync
tools.description: Start a sync of a knowledge source now. Runs in the background; check knowledge_source_status for the result.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: knowledge_source_status
tools.description: Sync status of a knowledge source: state (PENDING, SYNCING, SUCCESS, ERROR), last sync time, last error, entry count.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: ai_draft_reply
tools.description: Generate an AI reply draft for a conversation using the organization's configured prompts and knowledge base. Returns the draft without sending it.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: ai_prompt
tools.description: Run a free-form prompt through the organization's AI: it answers with the organization's persona and response rules and, unless disabled, the knowledge base entries matching the prompt. Use it to draft texts or answer questions from the knowledge base. Include any conversation context in the prompt itself.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

removeKnowledge.description: true answers without searching the knowledge base.

tools.name: ai_translate
tools.description: Translate a text into a language, e.g. a reply into the customer's language before conversation_reply. The language of the text is detected first: when it already is the target language the text comes back untouched with translated=false. An empty translation means the translation failed.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

language.description: Target language as a two-letter code, e.g. the language of the conversation.

tools.name: ai_test
tools.description: Simulate an incoming customer message: returns the classification the AI would assign, whether it would be spam, and the reply it would give, without creating a conversation. Useful to check classifications, prompts and knowledge.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search conversations, contacts, knowledge entries and messages of an organization in one call. Returns the top matches per type with the total count per type. Words are AND-ed and prefix matched. Use "quoted phrases", -word to exclude, and the operators from:<sender name or email>, subject:<text>, is:<open|closed|unread|read|assigned|unassigned|ai>, has:<attachment|draft>, before:<YYYY-MM-DD>, after:<YYYY-MM-DD>.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: template_list
tools.description: List or search the reply templates of an organization. A template can have language variants that reference it as parent.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

search.description: Matches the template name and text.

hasParentId.description: true lists only language variants, false only top-level templates.

tools.name: template_get
tools.description: Get one reply template by id, with its plain text and HTML.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: template_create
tools.description: Create a reply template.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

html.description: HTML version of the template; defaults to the plain text.

language.description: Two-letter language code of the text.

parentId.description: Id of the template this one is a language variant of.

tools.name: template_update
tools.description: Update a reply template. Only provide fields to change.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

html.description: New HTML; defaults to the new plain text when only that is given.

language.description: Two-letter language code of the text.

parentId.description: Id of the template this one is a language variant of.

tools.name: template_delete
tools.description: Delete a reply template permanently.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: prompt_list
tools.description: List or search the saved AI prompts of an organization. Classifications reference a prompt for their AI replies, and ai_prompt can apply one.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: post_list
tools.description: List the social media posts of an organization, newest first (order asc for upcoming posts, soonest first). Each post carries its text, status, scheduled time and its targets (one per channel) with their publish state and latest metrics.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

status.description: Filter by status, several comma-separated: DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, SCHEDULED, PUBLISHING, PUBLISHED, PARTIALLY_FAILED, FAILED.

from.description: Only posts planned, published or created at or after this time. ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.

to.description: Only posts planned, published or created before this time. ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.

order.description: asc lists the soonest first (calendar, upcoming posts); default desc.

tools.name: post_get
tools.description: Get a social media post by id: text, status, schedule, media and its targets (one per channel) with publish state, error, link to the published post and latest metrics.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: post_metrics
tools.description: Metric snapshots (views, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves, clicks) of every target of a published post, oldest first. A metric the platform does not offer is null.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: post_comments
tools.description: The comment threads on a published post, newest first. Each thread is a conversation (commenter as contact, status, classification, last message); read one with conversation_thread. Members see the threads they may see in the channel.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

tools.name: post_write
tools.description: Write the text of a social media post with the organization's AI: WRITE a post from an instruction (facts come from the knowledge base), or SHORTEN or REWRITE a text. Returns the text, with tooLong when it still exceeds maxLength. Nothing is saved: pass the text to post_create or post_schedule.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

action.description: WRITE a new post from the instruction, SHORTEN or REWRITE the text.

instruction.description: WRITE: what the post is about. SHORTEN, REWRITE: how to change the text, e.g. "more casual".

text.description: The text to shorten or rewrite (required for SHORTEN and REWRITE); for WRITE an optional starting point.

platform.description: Type of the channel the text is for (see channel_list), e.g. MESSENGER (Facebook Page), INSTAGRAM or LINKEDIN. Omit for a text that works on several platforms.

maxLength.description: Character limit to stay within, e.g. 280 for X.

language.description: Two-letter language code. Default: the organization's language.

tools.name: post_media_upload
tools.description: Upload an image or video for a post from a public https address (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, MP4 or MOV, up to 1 GB; the address has to report the file size). Returns the media with its id: pass it as media to post_create or post_schedule. An upload no post uses is removed after a while.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

url.description: Public https:// address of the file. Private or local addresses are refused.

fileName.description: File name to keep. Default: the last part of the address.

contentType.description: MIME type, e.g. image/jpeg or video/mp4. Default: what the address reports.

durationMs.description: Videos: the length in milliseconds, when known. The checks for Shorts and Reels use it.

tools.name: post_create
tools.description: Save a social media post as a draft. Nothing is published: schedule it with post_schedule or in FirstReply.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

channelIds.description: Ids of the channels to post to; only channels with publishingEnabled (see channel_list).

content.description: Text for this channel instead of the post's text, e.g. a shorter one for X.

targets.description: The channels to post to with their own text or platform settings, instead of channelIds; only channels with publishingEnabled (see channel_list). Settings by channel type: INSTAGRAM: postType FEED (default), REELS or STORY; shareToFeed (Reels, default true). X: threadParts, the texts of the posts after the first one of a thread. YOUTUBE (one video): title (required, up to 100 characters), madeForKids (required, true or false), format VIDEO or SHORT, privacyStatus public, unlisted or private, categoryId, containsSyntheticMedia. The text is the description. TIKTOK: privacyLevel (required, one the account offers, see channel_tiktok_creator_info), allowComment, allowDuet, allowStitch, commercialContent with yourBrand and/or brandedContent, title (photo posts), and musicUsageConfirmed true (required) plus brandedContentPolicyConfirmed true for branded content: set these two only after the user agreed to TikTok's Music Usage Confirmation and Branded Content Policy. GOOGLE_BUSINESS: topicType STANDARD, EVENT or OFFER; actionType NONE, BOOK, ORDER, SHOP, LEARN_MORE, SIGN_UP or CALL with actionUrl; events and offers: eventTitle, startDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD), startTime and endTime (HH:mm); offers: couponCode, redeemUrl, terms. MASTODON: visibility public, unlisted or private; spoilerText (content warning). TELEGRAM: silent (no notification).

altText.description: Description of the image for people who cannot see it.

media.description: Images or videos of the post, in order, uploaded with post_media_upload. Instagram, TikTok and YouTube need media; what each channel accepts is checked when the post is saved.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the post is planned in, e.g. Europe/Vienna. Shown in the calendar.

tools.name: post_schedule
tools.description: Schedule a social media post for a time: a new post from content and channelIds, or an existing draft (postId; content, channelIds or targets and media then replace its text, channels and media). It is published at that time unless someone changes it in FirstReply. When the organization requires approval, a member's post waits for a manager (status PENDING_APPROVAL).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

postId.description: An existing post to schedule. Omit to create a new post.

content.description: The text of the post. Required for a new post.

channelIds.description: Ids of the channels to post to; only channels with publishingEnabled (see channel_list). Required for a new post, unless targets are given.

content.description: Text for this channel instead of the post's text, e.g. a shorter one for X.

targets.description: The channels to post to with their own text or platform settings, instead of channelIds; only channels with publishingEnabled (see channel_list). Settings by channel type: INSTAGRAM: postType FEED (default), REELS or STORY; shareToFeed (Reels, default true). X: threadParts, the texts of the posts after the first one of a thread. YOUTUBE (one video): title (required, up to 100 characters), madeForKids (required, true or false), format VIDEO or SHORT, privacyStatus public, unlisted or private, categoryId, containsSyntheticMedia. The text is the description. TIKTOK: privacyLevel (required, one the account offers, see channel_tiktok_creator_info), allowComment, allowDuet, allowStitch, commercialContent with yourBrand and/or brandedContent, title (photo posts), and musicUsageConfirmed true (required) plus brandedContentPolicyConfirmed true for branded content: set these two only after the user agreed to TikTok's Music Usage Confirmation and Branded Content Policy. GOOGLE_BUSINESS: topicType STANDARD, EVENT or OFFER; actionType NONE, BOOK, ORDER, SHOP, LEARN_MORE, SIGN_UP or CALL with actionUrl; events and offers: eventTitle, startDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD), startTime and endTime (HH:mm); offers: couponCode, redeemUrl, terms. MASTODON: visibility public, unlisted or private; spoilerText (content warning). TELEGRAM: silent (no notification).

altText.description: Description of the image for people who cannot see it.

media.description: Images or videos of the post, in order, uploaded with post_media_upload. Instagram, TikTok and YouTube need media; what each channel accepts is checked when the post is saved.

scheduledAt.description: When to publish: ISO 8601 date-time with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-11-10T10:00:00+01:00. At least 10 minutes from now.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the post is planned in, e.g. Europe/Vienna. Shown in the calendar.

tools.name: post_reschedule
tools.description: Move a social media post to another time. Text, channels and media stay; a draft stays a draft with the new planned time. When the organization requires approval, a member's post waits for a manager (status PENDING_APPROVAL).

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

scheduledAt.description: When to publish: ISO 8601 date-time with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-11-10T10:00:00+01:00. At least 10 minutes from now.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the post is planned in, e.g. Europe/Vienna. Shown in the calendar.

tools.name: post_analytics
tools.description: Publishing analytics for a period (default the last 30 days, at most a year): totals, a daily series, top posts and per-channel numbers with followers. A metric no channel offers is null.

organizationId.description: The organization id. Use organization_list to find it.

from.description: Start of the period (posts published at or after it). ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.

to.description: End of the period. ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.
